FisherPoseStudio.description: Pose and position 1–3 people independently with a shared camera. Connect the prompt to prompt, the framed mannequin image to image_2, and the original to image_1. Camera Only mode does not use the pose image.

output_mode.name: Output Mode
output_mode.tooltip: Camera + Pose (视角＋姿态), Camera Only (仅视角), or Pose Only (仅姿态). Saved option values remain unchanged.

FisherQwenPose.description: For Qwen Image 2.1. Connect 1–3 character references in order. The mannequin reference is placed last and bound to the positive prompt. Auto mapping uses image 1 for people in a group photo, or assigns separate images in person-list order. Editor uploads assist skeleton fitting only; they do not replace these image inputs.

output_mode.name: Output Mode
output_mode.tooltip: Camera + Pose (视角＋姿态), Camera Only (仅视角), or Pose Only (仅姿态). Saved option values remain unchanged.

person_1_reference.name: Person 1 Reference
person_1_reference.tooltip: Auto (自动), or image 1/2/3 (图1/图2/图3). Saved option values remain unchanged.

person_2_reference.name: Person 2 Reference
person_2_reference.tooltip: Auto (自动), or image 1/2/3 (图1/图2/图3). Saved option values remain unchanged.

person_3_reference.name: Person 3 Reference
person_3_reference.tooltip: Auto (自动), or image 1/2/3 (图1/图2/图3). Saved option values remain unchanged.

use_default_template.name: Default Rewrite Template
use_default_template.tooltip: Use the default prompt-rewrite system template. When off, keep only the JSON output format convention.

FisherQwen21GGUFCLIP.description: Load the Qwen3-VL text encoder and its vision projection from GGUF or the vision part of a complete safetensors model.

vision_source.name: vision_source
vision_source.tooltip: Choose the matching mmproj F16 GGUF, or the vision part of the complete Qwen3-VL-8B safetensors model.

FisherPoseImage.description: Outputs the mannequin image and pose prompt without CLIP or VAE, for image-editing workflows such as Qwen Image 2511. Connect the mannequin to image1 and the whole character photo to image2. A second separate portrait uses image3. The prompt follows the person count automatically.

FisherQwenFreePose.description: Qwen Image 2.1 free posing for 1–2 people using the VNCCS_QI2_PoseStudio LoRA. The mannequin is image1 and the character photo is image2. A group photo uses the whole image: its left/right people map to mannequins 1/2 and can be swapped. Separate Portraits mode uses reference_image_2 as image3. Set mannequin reference size in the editor; node width/height control final output size independently.

FisherAnyAngleCamera.description: Render a coarse Gaussian-splat reference using the camera saved in the free-pose editor. For AnyAngle encoding, connect the front result to image1 and the coarse render to image2. Use this node's prompt, CFG 1, and 25 steps.

image.name: Front Image
image.tooltip: The front result from the first pass. The coarse render uses its dimensions.

camera_latent.name: Reconstruction Camera Latent
camera_latent.tooltip: Connect the latent output from TripoSplat sampling. Its original camera calibrates the angle; do not connect the front-generation latent.

FisherShot.description: Save the editor camera independently. When enable_camera is off, generate only the front pose; turning it on restores the camera workflow. The saved camera and front-generation parameters are preserved.

enable_camera.name: Enable Camera
enable_camera.tooltip: Off: generate the front pose only. On: run the full workflow with the saved editor camera. Turning this off preserves the saved camera.

FisherPoseResult.description: Select the result using the saved editor camera. A front shot returns the front result; other camera angles select the AnyAngle result automatically.

FisherAnyAngleEncode.description: Encode the front result as image1 and the new camera reference as image2 using the fixed AnyAngle prompt.
